name: usage-bar
description: A usage bar above the prompt: context fill, 5h/7d quota and cost, with optional git, model and prompt cache segments per environment

contextAmberK.title: Context: amber from (k tokens)
contextAmberK.description: The context turns amber at this many thousand tokens. Default 100; enter 0 to reset to it, as the settings page cannot clear a field. Must be below the orange limit.

contextOrangeK.title: Context: orange from (k tokens)
contextOrangeK.description: The context turns orange at this many thousand tokens: a good point to consider compacting. Default 200; enter 0 to reset to it. Must be between the amber and red limits.

contextRedK.title: Context: red from (k tokens)
contextRedK.description: The context turns red at this many thousand tokens. Default 400; enter 0 to reset to it. Must be above the orange limit. A window over 90% full is red whatever these are.

terminalDisplay.title: Terminal: show the bar
terminalDisplay.description: Draws the bar above the prompt in the terminal.

terminalGit.title: Terminal: show git
terminalGit.description: Adds the repository, branch and working tree state. Needs the terminal bar on.

terminalCache.title: Terminal: show the cache countdown
terminalCache.description: Adds the minutes until the prompt cache expires. Needs the terminal bar on.

terminalModel.title: Terminal: show the model
terminalModel.description: Adds the model and effort level. Needs the terminal bar on.
